verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE page says it produces an automated post-mortem from the incident timeline and Slack, so the core capability exists in the product itself. The evidence is a single marketing line: it does not describe the post-mortem's contents (contributing factors, follow-up items) or a draft-and-review workflow. AI-suggested Linear tickets are a separate downtime feature, not part of the post-mortem. Missing for 10: documented post-mortem structure covering contributing factors and follow-ups, an explicit draft/human-review editing workflow, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts the postmortem from the incident record — timeline, contributing factors, follow-ups — ready for human review

citations.quote: Get an automated post-mortem based on the incident timeline and Slack.
